## Description

Run the P8-001 intake for every P9 feature: who asked for it, the adoption target, and the rules that apply (DLT and opt-in for campaigns; NMC and DHA rules on patient inducements for loyalty points; regulatory class for any AI forecast). Record the DentalERP licence terms once for the whole phase.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Each P9 ticket links an approved intake record before work starts.
- [ ] **AC2.** The DentalERP MIT notice is recorded in docs/compliance with the files it applies to, if any code is copied.
- [ ] **AC3.** Release notes per feature use the P8 minor-version template.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
